notes.title: Snaky Survivor Update: A Whole New Way to Play!
notes.notes:
I've been working on a big update with lots of changes and new content! soul/health now plays a more interactive role, making strategy and exploration more important than ever.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/ccc203305d2a78fb54688cc06e5a55fdd884c280.gif

Levels are now organized in a map (with a minimap)

 You can choose which rooms to visit, but unlocking them costs a soul.
 New items added: keys, collectibles, and more!
 Think Binding of Isaac or Zelda, but minimalist.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/bc3fa75ac9a538ddd46b341cd89c34403aa67174.gif

More Level Types

 Survival rooms – Stay alive until time runs out.
 Enemy rooms – Trick enemies into taking themselves out.
 Exploration rooms – Navigate mazes to find the exit.
 Boss rooms – Defeat the boss to clear the room.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/1fe4b14ddee74e28bae5c7bfafce765cdfef889c.gif

New Player Abilities

 Dodging is more important – Use hazards to your advantage.
 Drop your soul mid-game – Use it as bait to outsmart enemies.
 More movement tricks – Dash, indirect attacks, bouncing, etc. (still experimenting!)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/58cb2d755f618296f5f76b83553529c434eee868.gif

Future Plans & Milestones

 Working on these features until the end of March/April.
 One full playable map coming in the update.
 More content will be added based on feedback.
 The original game will remain playable.


The original version (no new content yet) is on sale now! Grab it or try the demo—your feedback will help shape the game’s future.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2566240/Snaky_Survivor/

Fiery Squirrel

notes.title: Winter Update and Steam Winter Sale!
notes.notes:
🐍 Snaky Survivor Update: Unleash the Challenge! 🌪️

[previewyoutube=AeNDrhUFO2I;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey Snaky Survivors!

We're thrilled to bring you an adrenaline-pumping update that takes the excitement to a whole new level! Get ready to dive into 25 brand-new levels packed with challenges and surprises.

What's New:

🌐 Portals

🔥 New Enemies

🔄 Renewed Original Levels

How to Play:

Guide your snake-like character through the labyrinth, collecting soul fragments to stave off hunger. Navigate the hazardous obstacles with precision and speed, as time is of the essence! Can you beat the clock and emerge as the ultimate Snaky Survivor?

Thank You for Your Support:

We want to express our gratitude to all our Snaky Survivor players. Your feedback and enthusiasm continue to inspire us. This update is our way of saying thank you for being part of the Snaky Survivor community.

As always, we'd love to hear your thoughts on the new features. Share your experiences, conquer the levels, and let us know what you think on our social media channels.

Happy surviving!

Fiery Squirrel

notes.title: Update 0.4.4
notes.notes:
This is a regular update with few new features and changes.

Enemies Collision
Enemies collide with each other now. Depending on the strength of the enemy, when they collide with each other, some of them will destroy others. If enemies are the same kind, the general rule is that both will be destroyed. Saws, Lasers and Wall/Blocks cannot be destroyed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/4f25e18267491c684a491eccf3ff87fae3542ac3.gif

Rate Levels
I want to start improving the level design, whenever you feel like it, you can rate levels now. Depending on the results, I will try to change levels to make them more interesting.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/32d27bf0445a4ec7581f95a7bd75a19e9ad0cbac.png

Game Difficulty
Since a couple of previous updates, the core mechanics changed and every time you start a level now, health is restored 100%. This change makes the game easier, compared to the original design so I decided to increase the difficulty. Levels will keep evolving in the upcoming weeks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/79c3665c9da4f67b89a10f61124738d3f28346a5.gif

As always, if you've got any comments, let me know.

Have fun!

- Fiery Squirrel
🔥🐿️

notes.title: Autumn Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=UwM1aGpIgTc;full][/previewyoutube]

I've been testing this new update for a couple of weeks and I'm very excited to finally share it with you all. This new changes are themed around Autumn; it was initially planned to be a Halloween themed updated but decided to spend more time polishing the content and adding more new stuff.

Bomb
There is a new bomb type of enemy, it will explode after few seconds and whatever that is in the area (Player or Soul) will get hurt. In addition, if you or maybe the lasers hits it, it will explode too and cause the same effect.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/d407fe260450b602d74788609ecd72e8d87f094a.gif

Ghost/Bullet
This new enemy appears at the edge of the screen and aims at the player when appearing. It will follow a path straight to the player but without re-aiming so it's not as deadly but can go through walls, which tries to force the player to change position wherever it is.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/ccc203305d2a78fb54688cc06e5a55fdd884c280.gif

Levels
We have 15 new levels now, all of them featuring the new enemies in combination with the original ones. Depending on how the update is received, new levels might be added with these new enemies to increase the content and challenge as well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/c3dde80eead3594ea167e9d3357a03f12aad7eea.gif

New Ideas

 Level editor
 Color theme editor
 Zen mode: no time, more relaxed and less pressure
 More dodging skills
 Randomly generated levels
 Leaderboard & Achievements
 More levels


What's Next?
From the previous list of ideas I'll probably pick few and keep adding stuff to improve the experience. If there is anything from the list that you would like to play/experience first, just let me know and I'll make it happen sooner. Also, if you have any other suggestions, feel free to share them, the game will keep evolving and would be great to have your input for that!

Hope you enjoy the update,

- Fiery Squirrel
🔥🐿️

notes.title: Update 0.3.7
notes.notes:
Hello!

I've decided to make few important changes about the core mechanics of the game.

Lives as a currency
Lives don't work as a currency anymore. Levels now begin with a specific amount of health (most of the time 100%) and you will just have to survive by the end of the level when the time is up. Once you clear a level, you can go to the next one or replay it to get better results.

Continues
Since lives don't work as a currency anymore, continues (stars) don't make sense so I removed them too. Levels can be played as many times as you want.

Enemies damage
With the previous changes, the game is now easier so in order to balance the difficulty, enemies are more dangerous now. Damage was increased for all the existing enemies.

Level selector
There is a new menu to select which level you want to play, just a regular level picker, which now allows you to replay levels if you want get a better score.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/739d869a9bca91d2d79bea5119b7d77206fcd8d5.png

Credits
There is now a screen for credits. Go to Settings -> Credits. Thanks again to people that provided feedback!

Bug fixes

 Soul appears on top of enemies
 Bounding box for soul was too small
 Lives were not properly updated on the HUD


Autumn Update (Coming soon)
There is new content coming to the game, it's already prepared but I'll take some time to polish it as much as possible before release. You can get a sneak peek of the new levels below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/b9b6437abab8caaa372a89cf108d12c5cbd4c46a.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/1b383cc1a34b93783043ee7636fa85eea1a46f38.gif

Other features I'm working on for a future update

 Balance difficulty to match the new core changes
 Improve the level selector
 Improve current level design
 Level editor
 Colors editor
 New game modes: Randomly generated
 Leaderboard and Achievements


I'm also working on a demo that will be released after the Autumn Update, if you're still unsure about the game, I hope you can give it a try and decide whether you want to keep playing.

Happy gaming!

- Fiery Squirrel
🔥🐿️
